scope: PRSN-01 captured-ruler flag and reserved person flag audit

evidence.captured_ruler: capture_person sets bit13 only when the pre-capture status is 0; the predicate requires bit13 plus prisoner status 4; succession, death, alliance and release paths preserve the former ruler role
evidence.reserved_bits: all 33 mask-writer calls and typed person_flags consumers omit bit1 and bits21..31; both whole-word setters only deserialize or copy records
evidence.formal_samples: bit1 and bits21..31 are zero in all 20,800 person records from 20 formal scenarios and 6 tutorials
evidence.preservation: scenario load, object copy/compare and save serialization retain the complete u32

ida_changes.read_back: Renamed functions and all nine comments were visible after save and forced recompile; capture, release, succession, raw-load and repair paths all use is_captured_ruler
